UI_StudioLink_profileTip: The profile active in PZ Mod Studio. Only its mods are listed.
UI_StudioLink_appClosedTip: PZ Mod Studio is not running. The list is the profile as it was when the app last wrote it; what you ask for here is done when the app opens.
UI_StudioLink_newModsTip:
{1} installed mod(s) are in no profile (subscribed outside PZ Mod Studio, for example). Click to add them to "{2}", switched off:
{3}
UI_StudioLink_addFailedTip: PZ Mod Studio could not add the mods: {1}
UI_StudioLink_noAnswer: PZ Mod Studio did not answer. Open it and the mods are added then.
UI_StudioLink_blocked: This save uses mods that are not in the profile "{1}":
UI_StudioLink_howTo: Switch to the profile you played it with in PZ Mod Studio, or add these mods to this profile.
UI_StudioLink_empty: This save's mod list is empty, while the profile "{1}" has {2} mods.
UI_StudioLink_emptyWhy: Loaded like this, the game would run it with no mods and drop every item that came from a mod. Yes gives it the profile's mods and loads it; No goes back.
UI_StudioLink_backupBeforeLoad: PZ Mod Studio is backing up "{1}" ({2}) before it loads: {3} A big save takes a moment.
UI_StudioLink_backupBeforeFix: PZ Mod Studio is backing up "{1}" ({2}) before its mod list is changed.
UI_StudioLink_whyChanged: its mods are not the ones of its last session.
UI_StudioLink_whyUpdated: {1} of its mods were updated since its last session.
UI_StudioLink_whyNever: PZ Mod Studio did not see its last session, so it cannot tell what changed.
UI_StudioLink_backupFailed: The save could not be backed up: {1}
UI_StudioLink_noAppLoad: PZ Mod Studio is closed, so "{1}" cannot be backed up before it loads. It would be, because {2}
UI_StudioLink_noAppFix: PZ Mod Studio is closed, so "{1}" cannot be backed up before its mod list is changed.
UI_StudioLink_changesTitle: What changed since its last session
UI_StudioLink_changesWhen: "{1}" was last played {2} ago. Since then:
UI_StudioLink_changesRemoved: Taken out of its mod list ({1})
UI_StudioLink_changesReordered: The load order of its mods changed.
UI_StudioLink_mapsOutWarning: Map mods were taken out: what they added to the world may be gone when it loads, and the game saves it that way.
UI_StudioLink_copyBody: PZ Mod Studio is copying "{1}" ({2}). The copy loads; the save itself stays as it is.
UI_StudioLink_copyNeedsApp: Playing on a copy needs PZ Mod Studio open: it makes the copy.
UI_StudioLink_copyFailed: The save could not be copied: {1}
UI_StudioLink_screenBody: PZ Mod Studio and {1} both draw the game's Mods screen, and only one can. Which one do you want? <LINE> <LINE> PZ Mod Studio's: {1} is turned off in this profile and the game reloads its mods (a few seconds). <LINE> The other one: PZ Mod Studio leaves the Mods screen to {1}; save backups and the check before a save loads stay with PZ Mod Studio. <LINE> <LINE> You can change it later in PZ Mod Studio, Settings.
UI_StudioLink_cardNoChanges: same mods as its last session
UI_StudioLink_cardChanges: since its last session: {1} updated, {2} added, {3} taken out
UI_StudioLink_cardNever: PZ Mod Studio has not seen it played yet
UI_StudioLink_cardProfileClosed: Profile: {1} ({2} mods), as PZ Mod Studio left it
UI_StudioLink_inviteLine1: Mod profiles, a backup of each save before it loads,
UI_StudioLink_inviteLine2: Mod Health, maps and servers. Free, for Windows.
UI_StudioLink_modsMoreWithApp: With PZ Mod Studio open there are more filters: Updated, Libraries, a group, source and tag.
UI_StudioLink_modsCannotTurnOn: The game cannot load this mod on this build (or something it requires is not installed).
UI_StudioLink_modsAlsoOn: {1} needs these, which are off: they come on with it.
UI_StudioLink_modsMissingReq: {1} also needs these, which are not installed (subscribe to them on the Workshop):
UI_StudioLink_modsAlsoOff: These need {1} and are on: they go off with it.
UI_StudioLink_modsDiscard: {1} change(s) not accepted yet. Keep them?
UI_StudioLink_modsUpdatedLong: Updated on the Workshop since your last session.
UI_StudioLink_modsWaitingLong: Steam has a newer version of it, not downloaded yet.
UI_StudioLink_modsCantUp: {1} cannot go above {2}: it requires it.
UI_StudioLink_modsSortedByOrder: Sorted by load order to show the move.
UI_StudioLink_modsSearchTip: Name, mod id, Workshop id or author
UI_StudioLink_modsDragOnlyOn: Only mods that are on have a place in the load order.
UI_StudioLink_modsDragLimited: {1} stopped where it can go: never above what it requires, never below what requires it.
UI_StudioLink_modsManyHelp: Ctrl+click adds or takes a mod, Shift+click takes a range. The buttons act on all of them.
UI_StudioLink_modsAlsoOnMany: They need these, which are off: they come on with them.
UI_StudioLink_modsMissingReqMany: They also need these, which are not installed:
UI_StudioLink_modsAlsoOffMany: These need them and are on: they go off with them.
UI_StudioLink_modsMapOrderNone: No two map mods that are on share a place: there is no map order to choose.
UI_StudioLink_modsGroupHelp: The buttons act on every mod of the group. "Select all" on its heading picks them in the list.
UI_StudioLink_modsStateOn: On, #{1} of {2} in the load order
UI_StudioLink_modsStateOff: Off (no place in the load order)
UI_StudioLink_modsLoadsLastWhy: wins any file two mods share
UI_StudioLink_modsAppChanged: PZ Mod Studio changed the mods. Sync to choose which stay.
UI_StudioLink_modsSyncTip: Takes what PZ Mod Studio changed (profile, mods on or off, fix packages) into the game. What you accept here goes to the profile.
UI_StudioLink_modsSyncClosed: PZ Mod Studio is closed: open it to sync.
UI_StudioLink_modsSyncedSame: Already the same as PZ Mod Studio.
UI_StudioLink_modsSyncWhich: {1} change(s) made here are not accepted yet, and PZ Mod Studio may hold others. Which stay?
UI_StudioLink_modsAppNoOpen: PZ Mod Studio is closed: open it from Windows. With its Settings, "The close button (X)", set to keep it in the tray, it stays running, and this button brings it up.
UI_StudioLink_modsAppShown: PZ Mod Studio is in front of the game.
UI_StudioLink_modsFromApp: PZ Mod Studio changed the mods: this is its list now.
UI_StudioLink_inviteCopied: Link copied: paste it in your browser.
UI_StudioLink_modsGetAppTip: Mod profiles, a backup of each save before it loads, Mod Health, maps and servers. Free, for Windows. Copies the download page's address.
UI_StudioLink_modsGetAppCopied: Download link copied: paste it in your browser (Ctrl+V). {1}
UI_StudioLink_modsGetAppFailed: The link could not be copied. Open it in your browser: {1}
UI_StudioLink_errNoMod: in the game's own code (no mod named)
UI_StudioLink_errCopied: Report copied: paste it where the mod's author can see it.
